title: 寻找重复数
statement: 数组 nums 含 n + 1 个整数，每个都在 [1, n] 范围内，其中恰有一个数值是重复的（可能重复两次或更多次）。在不修改数组、只使用常数额外空间的前提下找出这个重复的数。

en.title: Find the Duplicate Number
en.statement: An array nums contains n + 1 integers, each in the range [1, n], and exactly one value is repeated (it may appear two or more times). Find this repeated number without modifying the array and using only constant extra space.
constraints: Only one value appears two or more times; every other value appears at most once
Largest local test has n = 50000 (official limit 10^5, reduced to keep the problem bank small)

complexity.time: O(n) (local training target, Floyd's cycle detection); binary search over the value range with counting is O(n log n)
complexity.space: O(1) extra space (official requirement), without modifying nums
complexity.officialRequirement: Officially requires not modifying the array and using only constant extra space; the follow-up asks to prove that a duplicate must exist and to give a linear-time solution.
complexity.notes: n is the maximum array value; the array length is n + 1. Treat i → nums[i] as a linked list; the duplicate is the entry point of the cycle. The judge cannot detect whether the array was modified or extra space was used (sorting, marking by negation, and a hash set all produce correct output); check your own code. The largest local tests are a random n = 50000 and a long chain with n = 30000 (official 10^5; full size would make the problem file exceed about 600 KiB).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the array length n + 1; line 2 has n + 1 integers nums. stdout: one integer, the duplicate number.

constraints: 只有一个数值出现两次或更多次，其余数值至多出现一次
本地最大测试 n = 50000（官方上限 10^5，为控制题库体积而缩小）

complexity.time: O(n)（本地训练目标，Floyd 判圈）；对值域二分计数为 O(n log n)
complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（官方要求），且不得修改 nums
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求不修改数组且只使用常数额外空间；follow-up 要求证明重复数必然存在，并给出线性时间的解法。
complexity.notes: n 为数组最大取值，数组长度为 n + 1。把 i → nums[i] 看成链表，重复数就是环的入口。判题无法检测是否修改了数组或使用了额外空间（排序、标记取负、哈希集合都能得到正确输出），需自行检查代码。本地最大测试为随机 n = 50000 与长链 n = 30000（官方 10^5，完整规模会使题目文件超过约 600 KiB）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行数组长度 n + 1；第二行 n + 1 个整数 nums。stdout：一个整数，重复的数。
